run_coop_mining_episode: run the coop_mining human player episode with WASD movement and gift beam controls
run_coop_mining_custom_observation: run the coop_mining player with a custom observation type instead of default RGB
run_coop_mining_verbose: run the coop_mining player in verbose mode to print debug information
run_coop_mining_print_events: run the coop_mining player with event printing enabled
run_coop_mining_custom_settings: run the coop_mining player with custom JSON settings passed via command line
